sources.author: Heval
patch_list: Disables telemetry and crash report uploads.
Forces a family-safe DNS filter and locks the browser's Secure DNS setting.
Hides default browser, rating and promo prompts.
Hides sponsored shortcuts, stories and suggestions.
Experimental: keeps background tabs loaded so they reload less often. Uses more memory.
